hypotheses.justification: The statement only uses `opFamily N ⊤ S 𝒪`. Its signature needs `[CommRing 𝒪]` and `[NeZero N]`, nothing else (Def_CohCarrier_Inst). The proof uses `diamondL_top_eq_one`, which is stated for any `[CommRing 𝒪]`. It also uses `CohCarrier.heckeT_comm_of_prime`, which has no assumptions on the coefficient ring beyond `[AddCommGroup V]`. `IsDomain 𝒪` is never used, and the theorem is true and provable without it. It is an argument only because it is an instance-implicit variable whose type mentions only `𝒪`. It can be dropped with `omit [IsDomain 𝒪] in`.

The statement and proof need only `CommRing 𝒪`. `opFamily`, `heckeTL`, `diamondL_top_eq_one` and `CohCarrier.heckeT_comm_of_prime` take no characteristic assumption. The hypothesis is an argument only because its type mentions `𝒪`. It can be omitted independently of the others.

Nothing in the statement or proof refers to a local-ring structure. The commutation of the Hecke operators `heckeTL` holds over any commutative ring `𝒪`, because it follows from `heckeT_comm_of_prime`, which is stated for an arbitrary additive commutative group. The hypothesis is an argument only because its type mentions `𝒪`. It can be omitted independently of the others.
